subject.title: feat(mac): dashboard gateway picker with in-place switching

question: Should OpenClaw ship dashboard-level multi-gateway switching and profile-to-primary promotion as a supported macOS workflow, after native upgrade and authentication proof is supplied?
rationale: This is new user-facing connection-management behavior, not an established bug fix, and it changes the product boundary between saved profiles, dashboard windows, and the primary gateway.

options.title: Sponsor the macOS workflow
options.body: Approve the feature direction once the contributor adds redacted native-app proof covering switching and eligible-profile promotion.

options.title: Narrow to dashboard switching
options.body: Keep profile viewing and window switching but defer primary promotion until its configuration and credential migration behavior receives separate product review.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the new dashboard-management surface if multi-gateway operation should remain confined to Settings and existing separate-window workflows.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the macOS workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the feature direction once the contributor adds redacted native-app proof covering switching and eligible-profile promotion.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies steipete as the only evidenced contributor for the proposed macOS gateway-management design; current-main ownership history could not be inspected.
